anchorSet.definition: Trooper deaths with a one-to-one CCitadel_Pickup_AssignedGold ground-soul match.
anchorSet.reason: These are high-confidence ordinary soul-producing deaths and therefore the cleanest available anchors for discovering the separate flying deniable Soul Orb.

strongestEntitySignature: High isolatedExactSpatialRate or very tight +1/+few tick distribution.
Small median initial distance from Trooper death.
Approximately one candidate entity per isolated Trooper death.
Lifecycle fields suggesting movement, ownership, targetability, health, active state, or destruction.
interpretationGuide.important: CREATE is not treated as authoritative spawn because pooled/PVS recreations have already been demonstrated elsewhere in the replay.
interpretationGuide.ifNoEntityCandidateEmerges: The flying soul may be represented primarily through particles, user messages, or a non-obvious existing entity. Use the death-local message ranking as the next lead.
interpretationGuide.nextStep: Take the strongest candidate class and reconstruct its lifecycle through spawn, flight, secure, deny, and expiry.
